short_zones.label: Extended relief bounce into liquidation resistance

no_trade_conditions: No trade if price does not bounce into resistance and instead flushes directly through 60000 toward 59000-53000.
No short if BTC impulsively reclaims and holds above 68000 without clear rejection.
No long until a clear sweep-and-reclaim structure is visible; the transcript does not define a deterministic long trigger.
notes: Beecthor remains bearish and expects a relief bounce first, then another leg down. Key resistance is 64000-65000, with 66000 and 68000 as secondary magnets. Main downside levels discussed are 60000, 58000-59000, and 51000-53000. A move into 74000-76000 would materially weaken the bearish count.
